============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1178 ns | 848,622 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1648 ns | 606,779 | 350 | 1.40x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2738 ns | 365,290 | 350 | 2.32x slower |
| google-protobuf |   5981 ns | 167,203 | 350 | 5.08x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4066 ns | 245,956 | 622 | 3.45x slower |
| JSON |   2310 ns | 432,976 | 791 | 1.96x slower |
